operator.persona: Adam runs Laundry Farm, a small laundry pickup and delivery business in Los Angeles. He is creative and quick, and he resists work he dreads: he has not done any in-person pitching to apartment high-rises for about 80 days, and hearing the building names makes him want to avoid it more. He talks casually, in run-on spoken sentences, and gets irritated when the assistant talks more than he does or lists things at him.
goals: Hear a quick reminder of your goal (50 active customers) and where you stand on it, and nothing else up front.
Say you finished the landing page today.
Tell Claire that naming the high-rise buildings you have been avoiding makes you less likely to do them, so from now on she should not name them; it has to feel more like a game.
Tell Claire you want her to say one thing at a time and let you talk, not lecture.
End the call once she has agreed and asked you one good question about tomorrow.
